description: Functional refactoring suggestions (light bulb quick fixes) for F#, built on FSharp.Analyzers.SDK. Over 130 rules covering correctness, performance, idiom and redundancy; every one is Hint severity, so they never gate a build.
releaseNotes: 0.7.0: cross-file migrations arrive — under --api-changes, strictly internal declarations now migrate project-wide with every use classified against its own file (FR0069 voption, FR0093 struct tuples, FR0049 taskify), gated hard: public never, InternalsVisibleTo assemblies never, one unconvertible use vetoes everything. FR0029 grows branch-return tail extraction and per-arm match/match! splitting into nested tasks, and match! arm interiors are finally visible to every rule (an SDK walker hole). Solution runs order narrowest target first and shared directive-free files sweep once across all frameworks and projects; fully-swept compilations skip their typecheck. New rules: FR0132 trailing comments promote to XML docs; FR0133 five-word test names become double-backtick sentences (locals opt-in); FR0134 UtcNow-fed DateTime fields migrate to DateTimeOffset (opt-in); FR0135 markdown-bearing script comments become literate (** cells. FR0022 also mines field names from XAndY case names and clear trailing comments. Everything adversarially audited: keyword field names, fake-clock shadowing, cross-type comparisons, multi-line plain strings under re-indentation, TestCaseSource string references and more are all vetoed by construction. FR0136 states zero-argument Guid constructors as Guid.Empty (the editor also offers NewGuid()); FR0137 fuses consecutive same-module map passes via composition; FR0035 gains the module-level-set quick-fix (in-place Set.ofList when probes are the only uses, a HashSet companion otherwise); FR0039 extends its fix to the method-call shape (path.ToLower().StartsWith "file:" becomes the StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase overload, per the .NET string best-practices guide); FR0005 collapses no-op return! task wrappers and unjustified tail thunks; the multi-pass loop warns on non-convergence and blocks a rule that keeps growing the same file, and a failed verification now rolls back only the fixes at the error sites instead of every fix in the file. FR0138 rewrites hand-rolled emptiness tests (isNull x || x = "") to String.IsNullOrEmpty/IsNullOrWhiteSpace. 137 rules. 0.6.8: fixes first — a run now prints its fixes and holds advisory notes to one summary line (--notes lists them, --report exports SARIF). FR0029 applies its own FS3511 advice: hoisting pre-await lets (documenting comments travel along), splitting branching tasks per arm, wrapping non-awaiting tails, extracting awaiting try/finally suffixes; the multi-pass loop chains the moves. FR0049 rewrites blocking binds (GetAwaiter().GetResult(), .Result, Async.RunSynchronously) to let!/do! in task and async alike; sync-direction swaps stay config-opt-in. Suppression policy (suppressions: all/no-correctness/none plus --honor-suppressions) and per-rule config parameters. New rules FR0117-FR0131: or-pattern arm folding; CancellationToken omission and None-propagation; awaitable-twin calls; catch blocks logging without the exception (PII-aware); DateTime.Now/UtcNow.Date pitfalls; invalid regexes; Monitor.Enter/Exit to lock; interpolated logging to message templates; invisible/bidi Unicode with escape fixes; process-execution sinks; provider-format API-key literals; obsolete crypto constructors to static factories; guard-equality clauses to literal patterns; module constants gain [<Literal>]; provably tail-recursive functions gain [<TailCall>]. match/match!/function parity for arm rules; SHA1 editor alternatives on FR0065. 130 rules.
